svg.title: Noctium: contract proofs and the full native Midnight capability goal
svg.desc: Research preview. Project goals cover full native ZKIR v3 (47 instruction variants and 15 native value types), a Lean contract language with checked proofs, ledger state and composition, private witnesses and guarded disclosure, Rust/C++/TypeScript/WASM/Kotlin/Swift SDKs, and reproducible proof-to-deployment assurance. Current evidence includes 38 scoped opcode names, historical private-claim Rust/C++ lifecycles and a 16-entrypoint token with 17 accepted localnet calls at recorded revisions. Latest source/native checks cover byte ledger values from zero through 1024 bytes and direct Native/Jubjub scalar decoding, preserving empty-operand assertions. Ordered transient field hashing also has scoped native/host checks, including empty vectors, legacy equivalence and cached-operand assertions. Typed ECDSA, Jubjub Schnorr, Ed25519 and Ethereum address helpers now have focused Source/native vector checks. Structured helper branches compile through shared guard lowering. Native structured entries now add typed scalar cell reads and writes against the owning schema, with ordered effects and proof-bound read returns. Typed guarded witnesses now have scoped native checks for skipped callbacks, canonical inactive slots, continuation calls and private staging. Full native coverage, signature assurance, composition, web/mobile SDKs and complete compiler preservation remain open. The capability panels show goals, not a claim of full delivered coverage. No Compact dependency.

g.text: Prove contract behavior. Compile for Midnight.
Author-written specifications. Lean-checked proofs. A direct native backend.
Full target scope · Selected programs; historical proofs
